dataList.content:
... Finally, the thirty days of lessons were completed, and the day of the final exam was upon us.
……终于三十天过去，最终测验的日子就要到了。

Everyone came out to bid good luck to Jia Xichun on her way to the final exam.
大家都在为乘轿前去参加最终测验的惜春送行。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Front Gates
大观园 正门

dataList.content:
My lady... I have nothing but absolute faith that you will be able to complete this final exam just as excellently as you have all the others.
小姐……您至今为止都做得很好，一定也可以顺利通过最终测验的。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
It is most likely you will be facing off against a skilled foe from the Xue or the Shi family.
恐怕薛家或是史家将会带来他们中实力最为出众的人选吧。
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Of course, you will doubtless wipe the floor with them.
当然，小姐您一定能轻松击败他们的。

dataList.content:
I have taught you all that I know... I hereby give you permission to leave this boot camp.
该教的我已经倾囊相授……你可以出师了。

You got this, Xichun.
做得很好哦，惜春。

Guys, you really didn't have to all come out here to see me off.
大家不必如此兴师动众地送我的。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Still, I have undying faith that you will emerge victorious, my lady.
是，我相信小姐您一定会得胜而归的。

dataList.content:
However, Zigong and I have also prepared about twenty-one alternative solutions in case things go... awry. So please, don't worry yourself too much.
不过，我已经与子贡小姐一同准备了二十一种对策以应对变数，请不必过于担心。
dataList.title:

惜春的势力

dataList.content:
... Do you have faith in me or not?
……你到底是相信我还是不信？
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Upon our return to the classroom...
……我们送走轿子回来的时候。

We were greeted by an unexpected guest.
回到教室时，一位意想不到的客人正在等着我们。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Special Lecture Hall
大观园 特殊教室

dataList.content:
Must be very nice to be Xichun. To have so many teachers, from all walks of life, helping her out...
真羡慕啊，惜春。有着这样各具特色的老师。

It had been a while since we last saw Xue Baochai, which was during the regular assembly.
自定期会议以来，我们已经很久没有见到过薛宝钗了。

... What are you doing here, big sis Baochai?
……宝钗姐姐，为什么会在这里？

I couldn't stop myself from paying you all a visit out of pity. If only... if only Xichun and Baoyu both smiled on like nothing happened...
我觉得过意不去。不管是惜春，还是宝玉……都只是站在自己该站的地方，静静地微笑着……

... our blossoming years would have been peaceful still.
我们的花季也本该如往昔一般万事平安的。

... Big sis.
……姐姐。

Please stop talking to me like that.
请你，别再这样和我说话了。

... I didn't know you could even say such a thing.
……你竟会说这样的话。

Baoyu, it has always been this way.
宝玉，我们从以前开始便是这样的。

If a fruit has fully ripened... we have to seize it and taste its juices before anyone else.
如果果实结得丰硕……我们就必须比任何人都先抢到手，尝到那果肉。

We can't just let go—we can't stand emptiness. My brother couldn't, my parents couldn't.
放弃这种事，我们做不到。我的哥哥做不到，我的双亲也如此。

But you, who was born and raised on the very same soil we were...
然而，与我们生养于同一片土地上的你却……

... how do you walk so softly, so lightly?
为何能如此轻盈呢？

I don't.
你错了，姐姐。

My footsteps are no longer light.
我的步伐不再轻盈了。

Every step, every sight I hold in my eyes as the days go by fills me with abundance.
每一天，新的风景都使我更为充实。

I'm only trying to accept everything as it is, without asking for more or less.
只是既不要求更多，也不将其削减。就这样原本地接受着这一切。

But how could one do nothing but watch... when we're surrounded by such fragrance?
但是……在被如此香气环绕之时，你怎么能仅仅是观望呢？

What more do you seek, big sis?
姐姐又还要寻求什么呢？

I want to be closer. That my hands may reach you.
我想要更靠近些。想要用我的手触及它。

... Have you already forgotten who had sent you that guest lecturer?
……你忘了外来的老师最初是谁安插进来的了吗？

Xichun's Palanquin... isn't headed to the exam site, is it?
惜春的轿子……并没有去原本的考场对吧。

No, it's not. It's heading to big sis Yuanchun's exam site.
嗯，去的是元春姐姐的考场。

... Blasted scoundrels!
……真是阴魂不散，他们竟还如此猖狂！
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
I must hasten after the palanquin, before I lose track of them...!
我必须在他们失去行踪之前赶紧……
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Wei sprinted outside even before Xue Baochai finished.
卫在薛宝钗说完话之前便冲了出去。

A trap, huh...
是陷阱啊……

Fellas, shouldn't we also get going?
伙计们，我们是不是也该赶快去帮忙了？

... Calm yourselves for a moment.
……诸位请先冷静一下。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
Zigong swiftly came between us, clearly having taken a gauge of the situation.
子贡似乎已经在外面了解了大致的情况，出现在我们中间站定。

It has been too long since the Palanquin has departed... it is better to move based on concrete evidence, not urgency.
既然轿子已经离开一段时间了……与其轻举妄动，不如根据确切的信息行动更为妥当。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
Though... a beast seems to have chosen the latter.
只是……某匹兽似乎没能冷静下来。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
I think I heard the faint sound of hooves coming from the direction Zigong was glancing in.
我想我从子贡所瞥的方向听到了模糊的马蹄声。

So this is what you've chosen.
这就是你做出的选择吗，姐姐。

Yes. The exams she's taken thus far were all... meaningless lies.
嗯。至今为止的测验都不过是障眼法。

I could've shared this earlier, but...
我本可以早些告诉你们这件事的……

... I decided to follow my own heart, as you have decided to follow yours.
但就像你决定了要跟随自己的心……我也决定跟随我的心。

Baochai smiled sweetly.
宝钗微微一笑。

So now...
那么现在……

... what fragrance do you smell from me?
我的身上现在有着什么样的香味呢？

I smell nothing.
什么都没有。

... Xue Baochai left the room wordlessly upon hearing that reply.
……薛宝钗听到了这回答，无言地离开了这间房间。
